name: zeroh
description: ZeroH plugins by Blade Labs: keep keys and personal data on your machine while AI tools do the work.

plugins.name: zeroh-disclosure
plugins.description: Keeps API keys, passwords and personal data away from the model in Claude Code: masks prompts and tool output as tokens, puts real values back only on your machine for allowed hosts, shows real values on screen, and signs a local receipt per turn. A local proxy, on by default, masks what you type.
